items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I met him years ago. In the early Thirties, I met him.

ctx.x: Yeah... I met him years ago. In the early Thirties, I met him. It could have been in the Twenties. Anyway, I met him out West. He didn't live too very much longer after this... I guess he lived seven or eight more years, I think.
